structure.description: VigilApp constructs one AppModel, injects it into RootView, and RootView gives Home, Models, Connections, and Settings equal tab weight.
Home and Connections both present AddAccountView. That sheet lists every manual provider before the two renewing sign-in routes.
Dashboard, scene lifecycle, and background tasks call AppModel, which combines account persistence, provider refresh, notification delivery, preferences, timers, and WidgetKit reloads.
The reference starts a live local collector when no hub is configured. It reads local tool data and pushes a summary into the renderer without first asking for an account.
The reference keeps total tokens and cost above its views, limits Home to short summaries, and turns each Home module into a drill-down entry.

patterns.name: Automatic core path, optional advanced path
patterns.usage: Token Monitor defaults to local live collection. Hub sync and manual provider credentials stay optional.

patterns.name: Summary before detail
patterns.usage: Token Monitor Home shows at most three limit accounts, two windows per account, and five model rows before a drill-down.

patterns.name: Provider grouping with account identity
patterns.usage: Token Monitor groups repeated providers and derives stable, disambiguated account labels before rendering account rows.

patterns.name: Collapsed configuration
patterns.usage: Token Monitor settings and provider account forms are closed until requested. The operational display does not begin with the provider catalog.

relationships.type: default route when no hub exists

key_files.rationale: Defines every permanent iOS entrypoint and gives low-frequency destinations equal weight.
Contains the copied Limits presentation, account setup entry, summary, full account rows, and refresh action.
Shows the desktop period control being translated into approximate provider-window categories.
Defines the first-use decision load and the priority between manual and renewing setup.
Central integration point whose broad responsibilities make presentation changes risky.
States the reference product's automatic local task model and optional sync path.
Pins the reference product's summary limits and progressive disclosure.
Confirms that reference period selection changes token totals but does not filter provider limit windows.

insights.observation: Vigil copies a secondary reference screen while serving a different primary job.
confirming_signals: Token Monitor defines itself around live token and cost data from local tool files, then starts local collection with no setup: token-monitor/README.md:27-30,98-101,143-145 and token-monitor/src/electron/main.js:2662-2687.

Vigil admits desktop transcript totals are unavailable, yet DashboardView and UsagePeriod explicitly copy the reference Limits and period treatments: README.md:156-159, apps/apple/Vigil/Dashboard/DashboardView.swift:4-6,105-133, apps/apple/Vigil/Support/UsagePeriod.swift:4-7.
insights.recommendation: Define Vigil as an iPhone quota and balance companion. Add a separate paired-sync path only if live token and cost totals are required.

insights.observation: The period picker assigns false time semantics to reset windows.
confirming_signals: UsagePeriod maps Day, Week, Month, Year, and Life onto approximate window identifiers, then falls back to mismatched primary windows: apps/apple/Vigil/Support/UsagePeriod.swift:38-69.
Token Monitor applies its period to token totals, while renderLimits reads every provider window without state.period: token-monitor/src/electron/renderer/app.js:3371-3434,4712-4779.
insights.recommendation: Remove the date picker from quota presentation. Show current urgency there, and use time ranges only for genuine observed spend history.

insights.observation: Home lacks a summary-detail boundary and repeats model information.
confirming_signals: Home renders every account, up to five windows, four primary metrics, and two secondary metrics per account: apps/apple/Vigil/Dashboard/DashboardView.swift:177-203,233-269,389-414.

Models renders the same model-window domain again, while Token Monitor Home caps summaries and opens detail on tap: apps/apple/Vigil/Dashboard/ModelsView.swift:61-97, token-monitor/src/electron/renderer/homeOverview.js:85-178, token-monitor/src/electron/renderer/app.js:4105-4145.
insights.recommendation: Show at most three urgent accounts and two values each. Open a complete account detail screen on tap.

insights.observation: First-run setup puts the largest and least friendly choice first.
confirming_signals: AddAccountView places the fourteen-provider manual grid before Claude and Codex browser sign-in: apps/apple/Vigil/Onboarding/AddAccountView.swift:24-35,100-209.
ManualEntryView repeats the full provider choice after the catalog already selected one: apps/apple/Vigil/Onboarding/ManualEntryView.swift:4-5,70-108.
insights.recommendation: Lead with Claude and ChatGPT quick actions. Put a searchable Other provider route below them, and keep the chosen provider fixed in its form.

insights.observation: Permanent tabs mirror implementation categories rather than recurring tasks.
confirming_signals: RootView gives Home, Models, Connections, and Settings equal permanent tab positions: apps/apple/Vigil/RootView.swift:38-77.
Models has three expected empty states and often tells the person to return to Home or Connections: apps/apple/Vigil/Dashboard/ModelsView.swift:4-50.
insights.recommendation: Keep Home primary. Move Models to a conditional drill-down, Connections to account management, and Settings to a toolbar destination.

insights.observation: Technical account identity is stronger than user-facing account identity.
confirming_signals: AccountRef stores a provider plus optional label and plan, while Connections offers removal but no rename or relink action: apps/apple/Vigil/Support/SharedContainer.swift:198-212 and apps/apple/Vigil/Connections/ConnectionsView.swift:211-281.

Accounts without provider IDs use a credential fingerprint, and replacement only matches the resulting key. A new manual token can therefore create another row: apps/apple/Vigil/AppModel.swift:240-275.
insights.recommendation: Capture stable provider identity after verification when possible. Otherwise require a display label and let an existing row accept credential replacement.

insights.observation: Parallel presentation components preserve old designs and invite drift.
confirming_signals: AccountCardView defines a complete account instrument, but repository-wide symbol search finds no constructor call. DashboardView defines ProviderHomeRow instead: apps/apple/Vigil/Dashboard/AccountCardView.swift:4-61 and apps/apple/Vigil/Dashboard/DashboardView.swift:222-416.

DashboardView defines StackedLimitBar and CompactResetLabel beside the existing LimitMeterRow and ResetCountdownView family: apps/apple/Vigil/Dashboard/DashboardView.swift:418-499 and apps/apple/Vigil/Dashboard/WindowRows.swift:70-176,243-273.
insights.recommendation: Keep one provider summary, one account detail, and one configurable meter family. Move StatusBannerView into a shared presentation file.

insights.observation: AppModel is an integration hotspot that makes product iteration expensive.
confirming_signals: The 922-line type owns UI preferences, account recovery, Keychain writes, snapshots, refresh coordination, notifications, timers, WidgetKit, and error queues: apps/apple/Vigil/AppModel.swift:1-83,114-167,259-393,539-888.

Its reliability test file is 814 lines, and every major screen reads the same mutable facade directly: apps/apple/VigilTests/AppModelReliabilityTests.swift:1-814 and apps/apple/Vigil/Dashboard/DashboardView.swift:7-20.
insights.recommendation: Keep AppModel as the observable facade. Extract AccountStore and RefreshDriver behind it before another full visual rewrite.

reference_product.true_task_model: Glance at automatically collected token totals, cost, and nearest limits. Open a focused breakdown only when more detail is needed.
reference_product.zero_setup_path: Local mode starts live file collection on launch. Hub sync and manual provider credentials are optional additions.
reference_product.information_hierarchy: Persistent total and cost, short Home modules, then full tool, model, device, session, project, limits, and trend views.
reference_product.provider_account_model: Usage tools and quota providers are separate concepts. Auto-detected sources are preferred, while repeated provider accounts are grouped and disambiguated.
reference_product.progressive_disclosure: Home caps its rows, modules open detail, settings sections start collapsed, and advanced sync remains opt-in.
portable_principles: Make the first useful result the shortest path.
Keep the recurring glance task above setup and administration.
Summarize first, then reveal complete account detail.
Use time filters only where the underlying data has time-range meaning.
Group by provider, but identify and manage accounts as distinct objects.
Keep unsupported or advanced paths out of the default route.
non_portable_affordances: Menu bar and system tray controls
Direct local switching of a desktop Codex account

refactor_impact.proposal: Extract AccountStore and RefreshDriver while retaining AppModel as the observable facade.
refactor_impact.import_updates: None if AppModel keeps its current public API. XcodeGen includes new files through apps/apple/project.yml:29-35.
refactor_impact.test_updates: Move persistence cases into AccountStoreTests and refresh cases into RefreshDriverTests. Keep facade and lifecycle coverage in AppModelReliabilityTests.

refactor_impact.proposal: Split DashboardView into screen orchestration, ProviderSummaryRow, AccountDetailView, and EmptyHomeView.
refactor_impact.import_updates: None inside the Vigil target. RootView remains the only external constructor of DashboardView.
refactor_impact.test_updates: Add navigation-state tests because the current test target has no RootView or tab-routing coverage.

refactor_impact.proposal: Consolidate meter and status components, then retire the unused AccountCardView implementation.
new_dependencies: Home, Models, and account detail -> one LimitMeterRow implementation
refactor_impact.import_updates: Swift call sites need no module import changes. Preserve symbol names during the move, then remove StackedLimitBar and CompactResetLabel.
refactor_impact.test_updates: Keep UsagePresentationTests and SurfaceHonestyTests. Add component-level state cases for current, stale, and degraded meters.

refactor_impact.proposal: Split AddAccountView into QuickStartSetup and ProviderCatalog, and make ManualEntryView accept an immutable ProviderSpec.
refactor_impact.import_updates: Only AddAccountView constructs ManualEntryView today, so its initializer change has one production call site.
refactor_impact.test_updates: Add onboarding routing tests for Claude, Codex, search, experimental labeling, cancellation, and verification failure.

move_guards: Do not move AccountRef, AccountIndex, SharedContainer, UsageService, or UsagePresentation during the first UI refactor. The widget target lists those shared files explicitly at apps/apple/project.yml:98-113.
Do not rename persisted account keys or UserDefaults keys as part of presentation work.
Do not add desktop-only file scanning, tray behavior, or account switching to the iOS product.
